declarations.name: getPokemonWithoutWins
annotations:
@Query("""
        SELECT p.*
        FROM pokemon p
        LEFT JOIN battles b ON p.id = b.winner_id
        WHERE b.id IS NULL
        ORDER BY p.name ASC
    """)

declarations.name: getChampions
annotations:
@Query("""
        SELECT p.name, COUNT(b.id) AS win_count
        FROM pokemon p
        LEFT JOIN battles b ON p.id = b.winner_id
        GROUP BY p.id
        HAVING win_count > :minWins
        ORDER BY win_count DESC
    """)
